title: Hoshino Ichika — Escape By Sea〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

meta.Event: One Small Trip Before a Big Journey

rows.Line: Red Brick Center - Building 1, 2nd Floor

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: What do you think...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I think it's a pretty good disguise. No one's even looking our way.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: That's good to hear. I guess it's thanks to this hat you've picked out for me.

rows.Speaker: Sonoda
rows.Line: Hehe. You're welcome.

rows.Speaker: Inoue
rows.Line: But coming up with a disguise is kinda hard, huh. If you go overboard hiding your face, it just makes you stand out more because of how suspicious you look.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: And Haruka looks good in everything. Whether it's a hat or some glasses, she just looks fashionable.

rows.Speaker: Sonoda
rows.Line: Hahaha. But then that becomes a different reason for people to look.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I think there's a limit to what Kiritani can wear, though. Even if it is for a disguise...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Tsk tsk tsk. You're naive, Ichi.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Anything that looks lame on us, Haruka can pull off like a total supermodel!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. I think you have a little too much faith in me.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: It seems like no one is looking at us while we're here chatting.

rows.Speaker: Inoue
rows.Line: Okay then, let's go back to shopping!

rows.Speaker: Saki & Sonoda
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (I wasn't sure what was going to happen after those elementary school kids noticed Kiritani, but...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (With this, she should be able to have fun without having to worry anymore.)

rows.Speaker: Sonoda
rows.Line: Oh, look over there! That looks like a decor shop.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wow! They're selling stuff from Scandinavia! That's so nice and chic!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Sounds interesting. Let's go have a look.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Whoa! Look at this table! The wood is so pretty!

rows.Speaker: Sonoda
rows.Line: These Scandinavian products have this really nice natural aesthetic to them.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: They do. I'm sure putting some of these in a room would give it a calming effect.

rows.Speaker: Inoue
rows.Line: I like the sound of that! Even just one or two cushions could totally make a vibe!

rows.Speaker: Sonoda
rows.Line:
Oh, the cushions are over that way.
I was thinking about taking a look. Did you want to come with?

rows.Speaker: Inoue
rows.Line: Really? Yeah, let's go!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I'll keep having a look at the lifestyle section here for a little bit.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I think I will too.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Me too! Hope you find something good♪

rows.Speaker: Inoue
rows.Line: Thanks! Alright, we'll see you in a bit!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, there's a catalog of the furniture over there. Want to have a look?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes, let's.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Wow, this room only has a bed, a table and a dresser, and yet it looks so nice...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: You're right. I wonder if it's because it doesn't look too lived-in...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hey, check this out! Is it just me or does the placement of the furniture kinda look similar to my room?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Huh? Oh, you're right. The layout and the way they've put photos on the wall does look similar.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, I see. Does it have the same feel too?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I'd say Saki's room is the total opposite. It has a much cuter look to it.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: What she said♪ I have a cute and colorful floor rug and decorated the room with stars♪

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe, a cute look, huh. I think I can picture that.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: What's your room like, Hoshino?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: My room? Nothing special, you know? I have a desk and my bed against the wall and a table in the middle.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: And...two windows.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, my room also has two windows. It's nice getting a lot of sunlight and having the wind come in during the summer.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oooh! Hey Haruka, tell us more about your room♪

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I have my bed near the window and next to that is my desk.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Also... I have some wall shelves above my desk, and...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: It's a little embarrassing, but I have penguin items around the room too. They're a combination of plushies I bought myself and ones given to me.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh right, you love penguins. So that means it's a pretty cute room, no?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
I guess if I had to say so, then yes...
But I also made space for my workout equipment, which doesn't quite fit the whole atmosphere...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Workout equipment?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Like dumbbells and stuff?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes. I also have a push-up bar for when I do push-ups and a roller for ab workouts.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: That's amazing! I know that you go running and maintain a diet, but I didn't know you also do strength training!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I do. Although, these days I mainly do it to keep my body in shape.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: To be honest, I actually want to collect more penguin goods and make my own little south pole...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: South pole?! Wouldn't you catch a cold?!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Why did you assume that she'll turn down the temperature too?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wait, what? I'm confused...

rows.Speaker: Ichika & Haruka
rows.Line:
Haha.
Hehe.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But a room filled with all of your favorite things sounds nice...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Maybe you should decorate your room with yakisoba bun cushions and stuff, Ichi.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hmmm... That would be nice, but I think I'd be happier with Miku merch.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hahaha, true♪

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hey, would you mind telling me more about your rooms?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Sure! I want to hear more about your room too!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Looks like Inoue and Sonoda will be a while, so we can keep chatting for a bit.
